slides.title: 15 years of uncompromising care
slides.body:
For 15 years, Kusnacht Practice has been redefining private treatment for mental health, addiction and complex health conditions.

Our approach was built on a simple belief: lasting recovery requires more than treating symptoms. It requires time, trust and a complete understanding of the individual.

Today, we care for clients and families from around the world with the same commitment that has guided us from the beginning — combining medical expertise with humanity, discretion and an unwavering dedication to each person’s future.
